title: When aggregate hours exceed capacity, an amber spill extends past the track's right edge with a tick at the 100% line
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on a desktop browser with Schedule: Edit.
2. Capacity Bars are ON.
3. One day is booked BEYOND the team's total available hours (seed extra shifts).
custom_steps: 1. Look at that day's capacity bar.
custom_expected:
1. An amber segment extends past the right edge of the track, showing the excess.
2. A tick marks the 100% line where the track ends.
